intent_en: To illustrate the shift in public opinion on same-sex marriage from majority opposition to majority support over time.
previous_intent: To illustrate the trend of increasing public support for same-sex marriage over time, reversing earlier majority opposition.
narration_support: Majority opposition in the 90s and early 2000s, followed by gradual gains in support through the last decade, and the emergence of majority support in recent years.
chart_support: Line chart displaying opposing trends for 'Oppose same-sex marriage' and 'Favor same-sex marriage' from 2001 to 2017, where support rises to become the majority while opposition falls.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly describes the trend of opposition turning into support over time. The chart visualizes this with the 'Favor' line rising from 35 to 62 and the 'Oppose' line falling from 57 to 32, crossing over to show majority support by 2017. Note: The narration mentions the 90s which are outside the chart's range (2001-2017), but the chart fully supports the early 2000s to recent years trend described.
